title: Design: Claude trading desk: a desk-manager session over specialist lanes (market watch, entry review, in-trade management = LTR, exit/post-trade grading), decisions as package-level intents through per-account risk, sandbox/paper first, every decision a point-in-time record the models train on
note: [2026-10-25 16:14Z session_01UKBXozpiJicMHHyMp47MnN] Operator 16:12Z asked whether to scope a 'trading desk manager': lanes for entries, market monitoring, adjustments and exits, managed by one desk session, in a sandbox, with all decisions recorded so the system and models can execute on them. Manager view: yes, scope it as a design after the LTR prototype has run on real trades for a few days, so the design starts from measured review rows (cost/decision, latency, hit rate).
